description: Product and vehicle recall lookup across US agencies in one call: NHTSA (cars, by VIN or make/model/year), CPSC (consumer products, by UPC or product name) and FDA enforcement reports (food, drugs, medical devices). Useful for safety checks before buying, selling or using a product or vehicle. Returns normalized recalls (number, date, hazard/reason, remedy, link), newest first, plus anyRecall. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for invalid input. PAID: $0.005 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/recalls/check.

q.description: product name or keywords, 3-100 chars, e.g. 'stroller' or 'peanut butter'

vin.description: 17-char VIN; recalls for its decoded make/model/year

name: recall_check
title: US recall check (NHTSA, CPSC, FDA)
